name: Carnival Industrial Corp.
summary: Carnival Industrial Corporation manufactures and sells garments and apparels in Taiwan and internationally. The company’s products include suits and career wear for men; womenswear; and dining or homeware products. It is also involved in curtain fabric and textile machinery business. The company was formerly known as Carnival Textile Industrial Corp. and changed its name to Carnival Industrial Corporation in 1997. Carnival Industrial Corporation was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
